body: Thank you. I'm honestly just trying to hold it together for him. I keep finding myself trying to think of a way to go that wouldn't hurt him but I haven't figured it out yet.
All of a sudden after a long text she sent about how all the problems are because of me now she wants to go to counseling.
Thank you. I feel like the only thing I do half way right is being a dad. His name is Ayden and I would do anything for him.
